subject: Request: trial runway extension because of integration hold
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@hyperbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Request: trial runway extension because of integration hold

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the platform looks really promising. Unfortunately our engineering runbook uncovered an unexpected dependency in our authentication layer that has blocked the adapter work. The team estimates another 3-4 weeks before we can complete the integration and run full-scale tests.

We are currently in our Redwood trial and were hopeful to have a production pilot starting this month. Given the delay, can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- extend the trial window by 4 weeks, and
- provision an additional 150k tokens of trial credit (or equivalent) so our integration tests don't get truncated?

We can provide the integration logs and a short timeline from our lead engineer if that helps.

Appreciate any flexibility you can offer — this POC is strategic for us and the delay is unfortunate timing.

Best,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Platform Integrations
HyperBank

Attachment: integration_log_excerpt.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@hyperbank.com>
Cc: Tomas Rivera <tomas.rivera@hyperbank.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 13:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: trial runway extension because of integration hold

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and for sending the log excerpt. Sorry to hear about the auth blocker.

We want to keep momentum here. Two quick asks so I can escalate properly to ops/finance:
1) Can you confirm the current trial end date on your account (so I can calculate a precise extension)?
2) Do you have a concise ETA from your engineering lead (a 1–2 line commit date) so we can set the extension window appropriately?

I'm going to loop in our SE and sales manager to review a bridge credit while we evaluate. In the short term we can likely approve a small bridge to keep tests running — I will confirm the exact amount by Monday after internal approval.

Would you also be open to a short joint troubleshooting session with our SE to accelerate the adapter work? If yes, propose a few windows next week and I will book it.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 08:45:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: HyperBank asking for 4-week extension + 150k trial tokens — urgent sign-off

Internal thread — please do not forward externally.

Liam at HyperBank hit an auth dependency that pushes their integration ETA out. Request below: 4-week trial extension + 150k tokens. Account details: DL-4729 (EU region). Attached: integration_log_excerpt.pdf and trial_usage_snapshot.csv.

Context:
- They are a strategic target for our banking vertical; regional compliance checks already passed.
- Current trial was due to end 2026-07-28 (per their UI screenshot).
- They need continuous test runs; if we cut them now we risk losing momentum.

Proposed options:
A) Approve full ask: 4-week extension + 150k tokens (marketing goodwill; higher cost)
B) Middle ground: 3-week extension + 100k tokens + SE assistance (lower cost, still generous)
C) Minimal: 2-week extension + 50k tokens + offer troubleshooting session (low cost)

Please reply with approval level and any constraints (legal/finance). If we go with B or C I'll handle comms and include a note about one-time promo.

Thanks — Marissa
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Internal: HyperBank asking for 4-week extension + 150k trial tokens — urgent sign-off

Marissa — I recommend option B. 3 weeks + 100k tokens, and we offer two 60-minute SE pairing sessions to unblock the auth integration. Metrics: based on their usage snapshot, 100k should cover their test matrix without materially impacting our promotional budget.

If finance pushes back we can land on 75k + the SE sessions; I don't think we need to grant 150k.

I'm happy to run the joint troubleshooting sessions next Wed/Thu.

— Rishi
Senior Sales Engineer
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@hyperbank.com>
Cc: Tomas Rivera <tomas.rivera@hyperbank.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: trial runway extension because of integration hold

Hi Liam — thanks for the details and the log excerpt. Good news: we've approved a one-time extension and promotional credit to keep your tests running.

What we've approved (one-time, non-recurring):
- Trial window extended by 3 weeks from your current end date (new end date: 2026-08-18).
- 100,000 token promo credit applied to your trial account.
- Two SE pairing sessions (60 minutes each) with Rishi to help clear the auth integration; possible slots Wed 21 Jul or Thu 22 Jul — what works for your lead engineer?

Next steps:
1) Confirm the slot you'd like for the SE pairing and provide your engineer's Zoom handle.
2) We'll send a short one-time promo note and update your HubSpot deal (HS-12345).
3) If legal needs anything, loop in HyperBank Legal and we'll route the promo confirmation through our contracts distro.

If the engineering timeline slips further, we can revisit, but this is what we can commit to today. Hope that helps keep things moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
